name: pcash
description: PCASH protocol, reference node, SDK, circuits, and marketplace profile.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pcash/sdk && npm run build --workspace @pcash/wallet && npm run build --workspace @pcash/relayer && npm run build --workspace @pcash/marketplace && npm run build --workspace @pcash/tokens && npm run build --workspace @pcash/lineage && npm run build --workspace @pcash/board
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @pcash/web
scripts.circuit-release:browser: node scripts/circuits/bundle.mjs exec -- npm run test:browser --workspace @pcash/e2e -- --project protocol
scripts.web:browser-journey: node scripts/circuits/bundle.mjs exec -- npm run test:browser --workspace @pcash/e2e -- --project connection
scripts.web:browser-funded-journey: node scripts/circuits/bundle.mjs exec -- npm run test:browser --workspace @pcash/e2e -- --project wallet
scripts.e2e:metamask: node scripts/circuits/bundle.mjs exec -- npm run test:metamask --workspace @pcash/e2e
scripts.web:browser-marketplace-journey: node scripts/circuits/bundle.mjs exec -- npm run test:browser --workspace @pcash/e2e -- --project marketplace
